0.comment: Acatl: Wrestling masks of the Collective of Plenty
0.content: Acatl explains that masks are a wrestling tradition in his tribe. A defeated wrestler must take off their mask, while the victor keeps theirs on and retains a sense of mystery that inspires others to challenge them. He has never lost a mask in a bout, against a human or a saurian. When tribe youngsters ask how they would know an imposter from the real chief, he tells them to doubt him in the ring.

key: Stadium of the Sacred Flame blessing
1.content: In the Archon Quest finale (Journey of Stars and Flames and When All Becomes a Monument, 5.3) the chiefs of the tribes gathered at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. Acatl told the Traveler that the Collective of Plenty came from afar to offer Natlan's blessing and respect, repeated Iansan's invitation to visit his tribe once the war was over, and later declared, "With us by your side, you'll never fight alone!" as the Traveler and Mavuika received blessings.

2.content: Before the Night Kingdom battle, Iansan privately asked the Traveler to visit the Collective of Plenty after the war, saying she and Varesa would show them the tribe's customs and fun activities. Acatl said the tribe could not wait to meet the Traveler in person, which is why he welcomes them as a guest at his tribe.

3.content: When the Traveler accepts his hospitality, Acatl praises them as a bold hero whose spirit the tribe's young people should learn from, and promises "the power of fine dining, Collective of Plenty style". Interacting with this branch the first time gives the player three Harvest's Boon.
